SITE INFORMATION

Privacy, in plain language.

Information about this website’s browser-local features and prepared enquiries.

Enquiry preparation

The enquiry page assembles the information you enter into a message in your browser. It does not submit the form to a company inbox. Copying or downloading the prepared message is an action you choose, and you decide how to share it.

Preferences and hosting

The home page may remember interface preferences in browser storage. Hosting providers may process technical request information needed to deliver the website. External reference links take you to independent websites with their own privacy practices.

Keep enquiries appropriate

Do not include sensitive personal information or confidential clinical records in a general product enquiry. Share necessary clinical details directly with the appropriate veterinary professional using an agreed channel.
